title: Watch Link Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
A watch strap, without the watch. A flat, flexible band of short rounded links set in rows like a jubilee watch strap, about 10mm wide and polished bright so every link catches the light. It sits flat on the wrist and moves like fabric.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Watch Link Ring, or beside a fine chain for contrast.

Details

  • Width: Approximately 10mm
  • Links: Rows of short rounded links, approximately 3mm, in a watch strap pattern
  • Stones: None
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
